observations: For Robin (requirement conflict, graded as written): with the catalogue perfboard grid (grid_margin_x 4.74, array centred: first column at X 5.71 on an 80 mm board) and the Pico's pin_from_short_edge 1.37 + usb_overhang 1.3, a Pico with its pins on the grid has USB_MOUTH X >= 2.07 and = 3.04 on column 0. The V1 delta window [-1.8, 0.5] is therefore unreachable without breaking L3.1.6.1 (grid conformance), so V1 cannot MEET as currently written. E1-01's equivalent window ([2.62, 3.62], grid column 0) would pass this design.

The four external corner bosses (Ø6.6 at (-3.287, -3.287) etc.) protrude 0.21 mm into the cavity corners (boss axis to cavity corner 3.09 < 3.30); the agent cut Ø7.11 notches in the lid lip there, leaving 0.25 clearance. No check fails, but the lip is notched at its four outer corners.

Keep-out margins are thin: lid lip underside is only 0.10 above V-KO-TOP and the floor top only 0.10 below V-KO-BOT; plug clearances are 0.40 vs 0.30 required. All pass, but there is no slack for print tolerance in these four checks.
